**OUH Odense Universitetshospital** is a major hospital located in [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src4]. It is one of the specific healthcare institutions evaluated in the annual report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP) for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src1] [^src2]. The hospital's performance is tracked across several clinical quality indicators to assess the standard of care for atrial fibrillation patients.

In terms of specific clinical outcomes, OUH Odense Universitetshospital was analyzed for [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the performance of echocardiography in newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients. During the reporting period, the hospital achieved a compliance rate of 79.6% (95% CI: 77.5–81.6), narrowly missing the national standard of ≥80% [^src2]. Conversely, the hospital successfully met the standard for Indikator 1 (wait time for anticoagulation treatment), achieving a 90.1% compliance rate [^src1]. 

Furthermore, the hospital's data was evaluated for Indikator 4a, which tracks anticoagulation treatment coverage two years after diagnosis. Here, OUH reported a compliance rate of 89.3% (95% CI: 86.6–91.6), falling slightly short of the ≥90% standard [^src3], though another related metric evaluated on page 42 showed a 90.4% compliance rate [^src4]. The hospital also tracks severe complications within one year of diagnosis; it reported an ischemic stroke (Indikator 15) rate of 0.8% (16 out of 1,986 patients) [^src5] and an intracranial bleeding (Indikator 14) rate of 0.7% (14 out of 1,986 patients) [^src5]. 

Overall, OUH Odense Universitetshospital serves as a key data point in the national evaluation of atrial fibrillation treatment quality, highlighting both areas of standard compliance and targets for clinical improvement [^src1] [^src2] [^src3] [^src4] [^src5].
